summary: Delivery Zones (Task 2.2) feature testing complete. All 23 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI verified - zones tab shows map with polygons, zone list with fees, edit/delete buttons, and create zone functionality. Map tab also displays zone overlays.

GET_zones_returns_seeded_data.details: GET /api/zones returns 4 default zones: Centru (5 RON), Semicentral (8 RON), Periferie (12 RON), Extins (15 RON)

POST_zones_admin_creates_zone.details: Admin can create new delivery zone with polygon coordinates

PUT_zones_admin_updates_zone.details: Admin can update zone name, fee, color, polygon, and active status

POST_zones_detect.details: Zone detection returns correct zone info for coordinates inside zones, returns 'In afara zonelor' for outside

non_admin_403_on_create.details: Driver and Restaurant users get 403 when trying to create zones

non_admin_403_on_update.details: Driver users get 403 when trying to update zones

non_admin_403_on_delete.details: Driver users get 403 when trying to delete zones

admin_zones_tab_map.details: Admin Dashboard Zones Tab shows map with zone polygons using Leaflet/OpenStreetMap

admin_zones_tab_list.details: Admin Dashboard Zones Tab shows zone list with name, color indicator, fee, edit and delete buttons

admin_zones_tab_new_button.details: 'Zonă Nouă' button exists for creating new zones

admin_zones_tab_edit_dialog.details: Clicking edit opens dialog with zone name, fee, color picker, and active toggle

admin_map_tab_zone_overlays.details: Map tab shows zone polygons as overlays along with driver and restaurant markers

seed_data_creation: POST /api/seed creates 4 default delivery zones for Bacău with real polygon coordinates
context_for_next_testing_agent: Delivery Zones feature (Task 2.2) fully implemented and tested. Backend: GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/zones endpoints work correctly with admin-only restrictions. POST /api/zones/detect uses Shapely for point-in-polygon detection. Frontend: DeliveryZonesManager component shows map with zone polygons and zone list. Admin can draw new zones (click to add points, double-click to finish), edit existing zones, and delete zones. Zone polygons also appear as overlays on the main Map tab. All 23 backend tests pass. All UI features verified via Playwright.
